text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can we talk?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Unless it's urgent, I'd rather
you rest after such a big race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
What is it? Unless it's urgent, I'd rather
you rest after such a big race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say it's urgent, but there is
something I wanted to say as
soon as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I realized something after today's race. I
don't think I've ever actually
thanked you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Thanked me? For what?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Even though I was on a different team, you
still approached me like I
was one of your
trainees.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And when I asked to move to your team,
you accepted my request
without a single
complaint.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's nothing special... In fact, I was
worried I might be
overstepping.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
After joining Team Sirius and getting to
know my new teammates, I
can tell what
sort of person you are.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You wholeheartedly believe in us all and
do everything you can to
support us.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to give you a proper
thank-you, but... could you
wait just a
little longer?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You really don't need to...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, I want to show my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And I'll do it by running with you towards
that beautiful scenery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she speaks, Silence Suzuka's expression
is soft and filled with the
same joy she has
while running.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's a thank-you like that, I
suppose I can accept it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's finally snatched her first victory
as a
member of Team Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her skills and heart soar upward,
I can't
help but wonder what sort
of views she'll
show me in the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whatever they look like, I'm sure they'll
be joyous and fantastical.
